description: FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub is an open data portal listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA). FEMA's resilience hub gathers hazard, exposure, risk and emergency-management layers, among them the National Risk Index, flood and storm layers, critical facilities and disaster declarations, each as an ArcGIS feature service or download. Coverage: United States. The catalogue lists 288 datasets, each with its own page, description and export options. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network and hazard studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
